note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations for the twenty-one members were received by Mr. S. Lecky on 28 April 1933; all were returned unopposed. Only eleven of the division names were legible in the available scan and are recorded here. Polling in County Londonderry took place on 2 June 1933. Filed on 1933-06-02, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Londonderry that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1933-06-01 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
